edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Shapesplitter clone has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and reaches 1000 — whoever spends it first owns the next twelve seconds. - Blooming Burst is 9s falling to 7s, so poke while her E is down. - Shapesplitter costs no mana on 16s; Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1.
